title: Application shell foundation
summary: Introduce a reviewed production build while keeping the same installed PWA and shared roster behavior.
changes: The GitHub Pages application shell is now built from pinned Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Motion dependencies.
The launch motto is the first isolated React region and respects reduced-motion preferences.
The existing service worker still waits for the user's update choice, delivers push notifications and keeps private Supabase requests out of its cache.
